Poolbeg Pharma to Participate in Key Conferences in September 2026
Poolbeg Pharma to showcase POLB 001 at leading scientific and investor conferences

3 September 2026 - Poolbeg Pharma (AIM: POLB, 'Poolbeg' or the 'Company'), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with a core focus on transforming the cancer immunotherapy field, announces that it has been selected to present at a number of leading international conferences this September.
All-Ireland Clinical AI Congress & AI Tech Expo
A new national healthcare conference dedicated to the practical adoption of artificial intelligence across the Irish healthcare system.
Title: AI in Drug Development: A Practical Case Study from an Industry Perspective
Presenter: Liam Tremble, Principal Scientist
Date & time: 12 September 2026, 11:15am BST
Location: O'Reilly Hall at University College Dublin, Belfield, Dublin 4
28th Annual H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference

A leading investor conference bringing together public and private companies, institutional investors and industry leaders for corporate presentations, one-on-one meetings and networking opportunities.
Presenters: Jeremy Skillington, PhD, Chief Executive Officer and Ian O'Connell, Chief Financial Officer
Date & time: The presentation will be available on demand from 11 September 2026, 7:00am EST / 12:00pm BST
Location: Lotte New York Palace Hotel in New York

Meetings: Management will be available at the conference in New York for in-person one-on-one meetings with investors on 14-16 September 2026. To schedule a meeting, investors should contact their H.C. Wainwright representative or contact Poolbeg directly at ir@poolbegpharma.com.
BIOShanghai Week 2026

BIOShanghai Week is a leading life sciences and biotechnology conference in China, bringing together global biopharma leaders, investors and innovators to explore industry trends, scientific advances and opportunities for collaboration and partnering.
Presentation title: From China to Europe: Raglan Capital - Sharing Experience, Building Partnerships in Biotech
Presenter: Cathal Friel, Executive Chair
Date & time: 18 September 2026
Location: Zhangjiang Science Hall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China
Investor Summit 2026

A leading UK investment conference bringing together 450+ private investors, CEOs, fund managers and finance professionals for a full day of expert insights, company presentations, panel discussions and networking.
Panel title: The Importance of Partnering to the Pharmaceutical Industry: The POLB 001 Opportunity
Panellists: Jeremy Skillington, PhD (CEO, Poolbeg Pharma), Chris Grimes-Crompton (Partner, Global Value and Access, Acumetis Global) & Michiel Bröker (Global Head of Pharma / Healthcare EMEA, UBS)
Moderated by: Ed Bowsher (Freelance journalist and investor)
Date & time: 18 September 2026, 13:40pm BST
Location: Upper Sugar Track, The Brewery, Chiswell Street, London, EC1Y 4SA
International Myeloma Society Annual Meeting

The International Myeloma Society Meeting is the premier global scientific conference in myeloma with a focus on basic, preclinical, and clinical aspects of disease. It brings together leading clinicians, academics, and pharmaceutical representatives to tackle the most pressing challenges in myeloma.
Poster title: POLB 001, an oral p38 MAPK inhibitor for the prevention of cytokine release syndrome
Presenter: Liam Tremble, Principal Scientist
Date & time: 24 September 2026, 12.00 - 13.00pm BST
Session: Session 1: Plenary. Global and National Perspectives on AI in Healthcare
Location: Scottish Events Campus, Glasgow, Scotland
If you would like to meet the Poolbeg team at any of the above events, please contact us at ir@poolbegpharma.com.

About Poolbeg Pharma plc

Poolbeg Pharma plc (AIM: POLB) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with a core focus on transforming the cancer immunotherapy field. The Company's lead asset, POLB 001, has the potential to expand administration of cancer immunotherapies from centralised specialist cancer centres into community hospitals by making the treatments safer through the prevention of the life-threatening side effect, Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS). As such, POLB 001 could increase the number of patients that can receive these life-saving treatments, thereby increasing the market opportunity. Poolbeg is also advancing the development of a patient-friendly therapy for obesity with an oral encapsulated GLP-1, offering a differentiated approach within one of the world's largest markets. With multiple near-term clinical value inflection points, and an experienced team with a proven track record, Poolbeg is focussed on partnering its high value programmes that are targeting large markets and addressing critical unmet medical needs.
